Free check · 1 minute

Could your foreign‑owned company owe a $25,000 fine?

There is a US filing most foreign owners never hear about — Form 5472. It can be due even if your company made no money. Missing it costs $25,000 a year. Check your risk.

By JK Accounting Group · For foreign owners of US companies

Built with JuliaFounder · speaks your language

Check your company

Three quick questions. Nothing is saved and no email is needed.

This includes you, if you live outside the US, or any owner or parent company abroad.

Please choose one.

Please enter the number of years (1 or more).

If you have never heard of it, the answer is probably 0.

Please enter a number (it cannot be more than the years open).

Takes about a minute.

Your result

Years that may be missing
Years the form may not have been filed.
Fine per missing year
$25,000
The set penalty for each year missed.
Get this checked and fixed — book a free call → A 20‑minute call. No cost, no pressure.

Why this is easy to miss

In plain words, so you know if it is you.

  • "My company made no money, so I have nothing to file." Not true here. This form is about the money that moves between you and your company — even the money you put in to start it counts.
  • It applies to a normal single-owner LLC too. If a foreign person owns a US LLC, the IRS treats it as a company for this one filing. Most owners have never heard of it.
  • The good news: the form itself is free. It is just information. Filing it correctly and on time is all it takes to avoid the $25,000. If past years were missed, there is often a way to fix it.

If it applies to you, we file it correctly and — if past years were missed — help you fix it the right way. Let's check together.

Send us your details and we will check it for you — in English, Russian, or Ukrainian. Or book a free 20‑minute call.

  • We tell you clearly if the form applies to you.
  • We file it correctly and on time.
  • If past years were missed, we help you fix it.

Optional. We will use whatever is easiest for you.

Or book a call now
